description: Compact older episodic history by archiving redundant entries and promoting recurring patterns while preserving the latest episodes, returning compaction statistics. Use for fast episodic cleanup; use `oxyo_sleep_abstract` when also distilling code traces into skills.

keep_recent.description: Number of newest episodes in the scope kept verbatim without compaction.

scope.description: Optional project/repo scope to compact (consolidates all scopes if omitted).

name: oxyo_consolidate
